text: Over the past 30 days, visitors have frequently noted issues with crowding and timed entry procedures, reporting that the library often feels too busy to fully enjoy the exhibits. Several reviews mentioned confusion or frustration around ticket purchasing, especially the requirement to buy tickets online in advance and the lack of cash payment options. Parking has also been a common concern, with some visitors finding it difficult due to large vehicles occupying multiple spaces. While many appreciated the interactive exhibits and architecture, some criticized the heavy reliance on AI in the displays and the absence of clear directional signage inside the library.
